title: red-server
description: red-server · 192.168.70.13 · role hypervisor · a Proxmox node, on its own hardware.

targets.expr: 100 - (avg by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="red-server"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (host, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="red-server"} > 0)) * 100)

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: One-minute load divided by core count.

targets.expr: node_load1{host="red-server"} / on (host) group_left () count by (host) (count by (host, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="red-server"} > 0))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Against MemAvailable, so page cache counts as free.

targets.expr: max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host="red-server"} * on (host, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label=~"Package id 0|Tctl"} * 9 / 5 + 32)

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Normalised to one core, so the stack tops out at 100%.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{host="red-server", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / on () group_left () count(count by (cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{host="red-server"})) * 100
node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host="red-server"} * on (host, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label=~"Package id 0|Tctl"} * 9 / 5 + 32
pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info{node="red-server"}
